Overview

Payroll That Doesn't Create Compliance Risk

Payroll touches more compliance obligations than most business owners expect — PF, ESIC, professional tax and TDS on salaries all run on their own filing calendars. Getting any one of them wrong creates liability that compounds every month it's missed.

We run your payroll cycle end to end, from salary computation to statutory filings, so your team gets paid accurately and your compliance stays current.

What We Offer

Complete Payroll Support

💵

Salary Processing

Monthly salary computation covering earnings, deductions, reimbursements and net pay, run on a fixed cycle.

🏦

PF Compliance

Provident Fund registration, monthly contribution filing and employee PF account management.

🩺

ESIC Compliance

Employee State Insurance registration and monthly contribution filing for eligible employees.

🧾

Professional Tax

State professional tax registration and periodic payment filing, handled per applicable state rules.

🔄

Payroll Outsourcing

Full outsourced payroll function, from onboarding new employees to processing full and final settlements.

Who Needs This

Any Business With Employees on Payroll

  • Startups hiring their first employees and setting up payroll for the first time
  • Businesses currently processing payroll manually or in spreadsheets
  • Companies crossing the PF or ESIC applicability threshold
  • Businesses expanding into a new state with different professional tax rules
  • Companies wanting to outsource payroll to reduce internal HR workload

Benefits

What Reliable Payroll Protects

  • Employees paid accurately and on time, every cycle
  • No penalties from missed PF, ESIC or professional tax deadlines
  • TDS on salaries computed and deposited correctly
  • Clean payroll records for statutory audits and inspections

Our Process

How We Run Your Payroll Cycle

1. Setup

We collect employee data, salary structures and register for PF, ESIC and professional tax where applicable.

2. Monthly Processing

Attendance and variable pay inputs are collected, salaries computed, and payslips generated.

3. Statutory Filing

PF, ESIC, professional tax and TDS filings are completed within their respective deadlines.

4. Reporting

You receive a payroll summary each cycle along with compliance status for the month.
